subject: general
question: Where can you find the emoticons in an instant messaging conversation window?

options.text: At the middle of the chat window
Any where in the chat window
At the top of the chat window
At the bottom of the chat window

solution:
The correct answer is __**At the bottom of the chat window**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Emoticons** are typically found at the bottom of the chat window in an instant messaging conversation.
 
• They are often displayed as a clickable icon or button that opens a panel with various emoticons to choose from.
 
• The placement at the bottom allows users to easily insert emoticons while typing their messages.
